messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — code freeze in 2h for v1.26. Please surface any late-change requests now.

mira: Heads up, I'm still waiting on CI for PR #5872 (model-quant-config). If it passes, can we squeeze it in? small docs + config tweak.

seb: How risky is the change? last-minute quant changes caused perf variance earlier.

mira: It's just switching default fp16->int8 profile for the dedicated pool when low-latency mode off. Benchmark looked fine locally.

casey: @mira can you paste the perf numbers? we need a quick thumb rule to decide.

mira: Sure — median p50 down ~8%, p95 unchanged. Token cost down ~12%. Verified on canary infra.

alex: Ok — that's promising but we need QE signoff. @eva can you run a tiny smoke on staging? just inference-sanity + smoke prompts.

release-bot: deploy scheduled: v1.26 freeze window starts at 2012347378. Auto-tag: freeze/v1.26. See /releases for details. :lock:

eva: starting smoke now. ETA 20m. will report any diffs > 1% on quality checks.

seb: Also, changelog — did we get a short blurb for that var-int8 change? Need one line.

mira: adding: "Serve default quantization profile updated to int8 for non-low-latency requests — cost/perf improved; contact infra for rollback."

casey: If QE fails, what's rollback? ops-bot, can you confirm the roll-back playbook id?

ops-bot: rollback playbook: RB-003. To rollback v1.26 artifact: run `release rollback --env=staging --tag=freeze/v1.26` then follow RB-003 checklist.

alex: Good. Two more things: 1) any last-minute external infra deps (DB migration, cert renewals)? 2) Late-merge exception requests?

dana: DB migration scheduled last night completed, no outstanding jobs. certs OK.

seb: I have a late-merge exception request: tiny docs fix + changelog tweak in #5899. low risk but just over cutoff. Can we do exception?

alex: Please paste PR link and why it's important in-line. We'll vote.

seb: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5899 — fixes misleading changelog entry that would confuse customers about batching defaults. No code changes.

casey: Vote: +1 from infra (acceptable).

mira: Vote: +1 from runtime.

eva: QE: +1 (docs only).

alex: Exception approved — merge but use branch protection hold for 10m for quick rollback window. Also add clear changelog note: "docs-only, low-risk".

seb: Merged and added note. Thanks. :thumbsup:

release-bot: note: exception logged under release-exceptions/2012345678.

eva: Smoke done — no regression detected on the sample prompts. Cleared for release from QE side.

alex: Great. Final checklist: update changelog entry, tag freeze, create release candidate in /releases, and set monitoring alerts for the next 2h token-rate anomaly. @ops-bot schedule alerts.

ops-bot: Alerts scheduled: infra-token-rate (threshold 2x baseline), latency-p95 (threshold +30%). Post-deploy window set 120m.

casey: I'll be on call during the window. If anything odd, ping #eng-oncall and @casey.

alex: Thanks everyone. If anybody else has a last-minute ask, now's the time — otherwise I'll kick the release at freeze time.

mira: All good from my side. GLHF. :rocket:
